en: The image is a sepia-toned photograph of a classical statue, likely representing a draped female figure, standing outdoors among ancient ruins. The statue is missing its head and arms, typical of many ancient sculptures. There are stone blocks, columns, and lush vegetation in the background, suggesting a historical archaeological site. At the bottom, there is French text identifying the location and subject.
